HallTimers.name: Default
HallTimers.description: Each player has a total time bank of 45 minutes, and will time out with a loss if they run out of their time bank or take longer than 6 minutes between actions.

HallTimers.name: Blitz!
HallTimers.description: Each player has a total time bank of 25 minutes, and will time out with a loss if they run out of their time bank or take longer than 3 minutes between actions.

HallTimers.name: WC
HallTimers.description: Each player has a total time bank of 20 minutes, and will time out with a loss if they run out of their time bank or take longer than 10 minutes between actions.

HallTimers.name: Slow
HallTimers.description: Each player has a total time bank of 80 minutes, and will time out with a loss if they run out of their time bank or take longer than 10 minutes between actions.

HallTimers.name: Glacial
HallTimers.description: Each player has a total time bank of 1 day, and will time out with a loss if they run out of their time bank or take longer than 1 day between actions.
